behaviors.description: The pantry summary CLI reads the request and required rule items, then prints the complete exact summary.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: List pantry produces Summary for List pantry: apples, pears followed by one newline and exit code 0.

behaviors.description: The pantry summary CLI rejects a malformed request before producing a summary.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: A type-violating request exits 2 and prints error: invalid list request on stderr.

directions.text: The summarize command (with the supplied stdin prompt): its exit code and the standard output you obtained is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. Exit code and whole stdout of the summary step. A failed process or any omitted, added, reordered or changed output byte, including the newline is treated as a defect.

The summarize command (with a malformed stdin prompt value): its exit code, the standard error you obtained, and the standard output you obtained is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. Exit code, whole stderr, and whole stdout of the malformed request step. A malformed request receives a summary, a different error, or a different exit code is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: Only the adopter-owned rule JSON or request guard may be mutated in the copied workspace.
